correctness.rationale: For a species with occupancy d, exactly d*C(N−d,k−1) of C(N,k) k-site samples contain it once, giving g_d(k). Linearity yields u_k=g_a(k)+g_b(k) even when species supports overlap. The ratio g_d(k+1)/g_d(k) has sign of difference controlled by N+1−d(k+1), proving single-species unimodality. Independently enumerated every N=2..15 and every 1<=a<=b<=N, exactly 679 occupancy triples, with exact rational fractions and strict interior peak tests; exactly one double-peak case N15 (2,9) with peaks at k=2,7. Rechecked witness fractions and distinct neighboring comparisons. Separately inspected full Git verify.py that additionally enumerates all 2^15 site subsets for both disjoint/nested representations. The finite census is exhaustive for the stated finite parameter domain, not a numerical extrapolation. u_k/k nonincreasing is separately justified via hypergeometric avoidance probability and is not claimed novel.
